comments.text: Kiya star health insurance mai 24 hours hospitalized huna porega claim ke liye ??
comments.author: @arunarun-nw3dx

comments.text:
Star Health Insurance ke claims ke liye, kuch policies me hospitalization ka minimum duration ka requirement ho sakta hai, jo aam tor par 24 hours hota hai. Matlab, agar aapko claim lena hai, toh aapko hospital me kam se kam 24 ghante admit rehna padega.

Lekin yeh requirement policy ke type aur conditions par depend karti hai. Kuch cases me, agar aapko minor surgery ya treatment ki zarurat ho, toh daycare treatment bhi cover ho sakta hai, jo 24 ghante se kam time ke liye hospital me rehne par bhi claim ho sakta hai.

Aapko apni policy ki terms and conditions ko dhyan se padhna chahiye ya apne insurance provider se direct contact karke clarification lena chahiye.
comments.author: @PolicyXcomindia

comments.text: Does this policy cover treatments for anxiety disorder?
comments.author: @shammishrivastav

comments.text: Yes, Star Health Assure Policy covers anxiety disorder if hospitalization is required (minimum 24 hours), as per the Mental Healthcare Act 2017.
